CLOSE-AS-STALE

The transcript shows the check passes today: `uv run pytest tests/test_terminals.py tests/web/test_terminal_ws.py -q -W error::DeprecationWarning` exits 0 with "13 passed in 1.36s". This means the DeprecationWarning is already not being emitted as an error in these tests—the behavior the criterion demands is already present. When the same tests run *without* `-W error::DeprecationWarning`, warnings appear but don't fail. The check cannot discriminate because it passes before any implementation work is done; the symptom this issue reports (warnings dirtying the suite) exists only under the default warning filter, not under the proposed check's stricter filter.
